spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the workspace owner may write an unprotected exact-price lock through delegated MCP. Seller-protected locks refuse delegated writes.
The all_marketplaces scope is fixed by the existing SKU lock contract. This tool does not restore a price or trigger repricing.
An agent cannot set or disable lock protection. Clear an unprotected lock with spellbook_sku_exact_price_lock_clear.

description: Set one seller SKU's unprotected exact-price lock and return its saved readback. Identify the exact printing, finish and condition. A seller-protected lock refuses agent changes. Call spellbook_sku_price_controls first to inspect protection. Saving a lock does not publish or trigger repricing.

condition.description: The exact physical condition for the SKU. Required.

finish.description: The exact finish for the SKU: nf, fo, etched, surge, rh, 1e or 1e-fo. Required.

priceUsd.description: The seller-selected exact locked price in USD. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact Scryfall printing id. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_sku_exact_price_lock_set
